description: This Go source file defines the VCStorage struct and its methods for managing verifiable credentials (VCs), including storing, retrieving, querying, and converting VC data, with support for different storage backends.

classes.name: VCStorage
classes.description: A struct managing storage and retrieval of verifiable credentials, supporting various storage backends.

methods.name: NewVCStorageWithStorage
methods.description: Creates a new VCStorage instance with the specified storage provider.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Performs a sanity check to verify storage provider availability.

methods.name: StoreExecutionVC
methods.description: Stores an execution verifiable credential using the storage provider.

methods.name: GetExecutionVC
methods.description: Retrieves a single execution VC by its ID.

methods.name: GetExecutionVCsByWorkflow
methods.description: Retrieves all VCs associated with a specific workflow.

methods.name: GetExecutionVCsBySession
methods.description: Retrieves all VCs associated with a specific session.

methods.name: GetExecutionVCByExecutionID
methods.description: Fetches the most recent VC for a given execution ID.

methods.name: QueryExecutionVCs
methods.description: Runs a filtered query for execution VCs.

methods.name: ListWorkflowVCStatusSummaries
methods.description: Returns aggregated VC statistics for specified workflows.

methods.name: StoreWorkflowVC
methods.description: Stores workflow-level VC metadata.

methods.name: GetWorkflowVC
methods.description: Fetches the latest workflow VC for a given workflow ID.

methods.name: ListWorkflowVCs
methods.description: Lists all stored workflow VCs.

methods.name: DeleteExecutionVC
methods.description: Placeholder for deleting an execution VC (no-op).

methods.name: DeleteWorkflowVC
methods.description: Placeholder for deleting a workflow VC (no-op).

methods.name: GetVCStats
methods.description: Provides simple metrics about stored VCs.

methods.name: convertVCInfoToExecutionVC
methods.description: Converts VC info to a full ExecutionVC object, loading full VC document and signature.

methods.name: convertWorkflowVCInfo
methods.description: Converts stored workflow VC info to a WorkflowVC object.

methods.name: loadExecutionVCsFromDatabaseWithFilters
methods.description: Retrieves execution VCs matching specific filters.

methods.name: getFullVCFromDatabase
methods.description: Retrieves full VC document and signature from storage backend.

methods.name: getFullVCFromLocalStorage
methods.description: Retrieves full VC payload from local SQLite storage.
